title: Paid ads numbers arrive by themselves: fwd pulls the campaign's daily cost, clicks and purchases from Google Analytics
description: The paid ads flow (FW-C-053) only knows what the Owner exports from Google Ads by hand, and the Owner wants tracking hooked up automatically. Google Ads is linked to the Frequency GA4 property, which carries the campaign's cost, clicks and impressions plus the purchase key event. Add a ga4 block to flows/paid-ads/config.json (property_id, a credential handle, pull_every_hours, lookback_days). When it is present, fwd itself pulls on start and then every pull_every_hours: it signs in with the service account key behind the handle (an RS256 assertion for the analytics.readonly scope only), calls the GA4 Data API runReport for daily advertiserAdImpressions, advertiserAdClicks, advertiserAdCost and keyEvents:purchase by sessionGoogleAdsCampaignName, and writes the rows as a report file in $FW_HOME/flows/paid-ads/imports/, so the view reads them like a dropped-in CSV. GET /v1/flows/paid-ads gains pull {property_id, every_hours, last {ok, at, days?, error?}}, and the Flows page shows when numbers were last pulled or why the pull failed. A failed pull never stops fwd and never prints or stores the key. FW_GA4_TOKEN_URL and FW_GA4_API_BASE point the pull at a local fake for tests. The pull only reads: no Ads API, no change to the campaign.
acceptance: flows/paid-ads/config.json names a GA4 property and a credential handle, and holds no key material

With a service account key behind the handle, fwd pulls on its own, signing in for the analytics.readonly scope with an assertion the key verifies and calling runReport for the configured property with the access token
After the pull, GET /v1/flows/paid-ads totals match the campaign's rows and ignore other campaigns, and pull.last.ok is true
With no key, fwd keeps serving the view; pull.last.ok is false and the error names the handle
The private key never appears in fwd output or the view
